pre_command: defaults write com.apple.Notes windowStateArchive -dict-add currentNoteContainerViewMode 0 && osascript -e 'tell application "Notes" to make new note with properties {name:"Lorem Ipsum", body:"Dolor Sit Amet"}' && osascript -e 'tell application "Notes" to delete every note' -e 'tell application "Notes" to delete every note in folder "Recently Deleted"' && osascript -e 'tell application "Notes" to quit'
instruction: A colleague requests that you create a note titled Grocery List containing a bullet list with these items: "Milk", "Bread", and "Eggs".
evaluator: osascript -e 'tell application "Notes" to get the body of every note' | grep -q "<h1>Grocery" && osascript -e 'tell application "Notes" to get the body of every note' | grep -q "<li>Milk" && osascript -e 'tell application "Notes" to get the body of every note' | grep -q "<li>Bread" && osascript -e 'tell application "Notes" to get the body of every note' | grep -q "<li>Eggs" && echo "True" || echo "False"
